title: Nektar — Git & Time Machine for Your AI's Brain

scenes.vo: Where does your AI's memory actually live? Trapped in someone else's cloud — you can't inspect it, back it up, or take it with you.
scenes.subtitle: Where does your AI's memory live? Trapped in a cloud black box you can't inspect or export.

scenes.vo: Meet Nektar: Git and Time Machine for your AI's brain. Every lesson saves like a commit — inspect diffs, branch experiments, and keep history tamper-proof.
scenes.subtitle: Git + Time Machine for your AI's brain — inspect diffs, branch experiments, tamper-proof history.

scenes.vo: Click Export to pack your project's AI brain into one portable file. Move it to a new laptop or a teammate — their AI wakes up ready.
scenes.subtitle: Click Export -> one portable project-brain.nkt file. Drop it on any laptop and AI wakes up ready.

scenes.vo: Saved a secret by mistake? Hit Forget. It shreds into harmless static right on your disk, while the rest of your history stays intact.
scenes.subtitle: Click Forget — sensitive notes shred into static on disk while the rest of your history stays verified.

scenes.vo: One lightweight local app for solo builders and real teams. Push and pull AI knowledge with Git, work completely offline, with zero lock-in.
scenes.subtitle: One lightweight local app · Standard Git workflow · Works offline · Zero vendor lock-in.

scenes.vo: Own your AI's memory forever. Run nektar up, at nektar dot run.
